pv50:1.1: Saṭṭhivassasahassāni paripuṇṇāni sabbaso niraye paccamānānaṃ kadā anto bhavissati. || ||
pv50:2.1: Natthi anto kuto anto na anto patidissati tathā hi pakataṃ pāpaṃ mama tuyhañ ca mārisa. || ||
pv50:3.1: Dujjīvitam ajīvamha ye sante na dadamhase santesu deyyadhammesu dīpaṃ nākamha attano. || ||
pv50:4.1: So hi nūna ito gantvā yoniṃ laddhāna mānusiṃ vadaññū sīlasampanno kāhāmi kusalaṃ bahun ti. || ||
